decision: disposition: needs follow-up — Reaver_Radiator_Starboard (and Port) float detached in empty space outside Reaver_Pressure_Hull, plus loosely mounted Reaver_HeavyCannon, protruding flat Reaver_Repair_Panel/CargoDoor_Port slabs, overhanging Reaver_Decal_Tag, and recessed stern drive.
next: Bridge Reaver_Radiator_* and Reaver_HeavyCannon to the hull with structural mounting struts/collars, conform repair/cargo panels and Reaver_Decal_Tag to the loft surface, expose Reaver_Drive nozzle behind the aft cap, verify at nominal scale and lod2, and recapture.
